sourceSentences: [0] Here's why engage supports aren't worth your ban. Yuumi isn't going to be dying to hooks and grabs the same way other supports are in the lane phase
[0] She's attached to you. So, most of the aggression just misses
[0] They'll rush in without their ADC early and you just isolate the 2v1
[1] Alistar's headbutt-pulverize combo (W + Q) allows him to quickly engage and burst down either Yuumi or her ADC before Yuumi's shields and heals can take effect
[1] If Yuumi detaches even briefly to heal or reposition, Alistar can capitalize on that moment to land crowd control and set up kills
[1] If Alistar is in your game, he can guarantee a dive at level 6, so be carful of this
[2] when she dismounts herself and you combo her, she is guaranteed dead as you have enough crowd control to keep her dismounted
[2] You can abuse this by just landing ANY CC on her as she can't reattach to her ally for 5 seconds
[2] Yuumi is not adding much to her lane when playing against you. She will poke and sustain, but when you combo her adc she can't do much
[2] when she jumps off to get her passive shield you all in her and she cant do anythign for roughly 5 seconds after ccing her
